title: Best Hair Dryers UK
short: Hair dryers compared by hair type, power and weight, from travel-friendly picks to salon-grade dryers.
intro: The best hair dryer for you depends heavily on your hair type as much as raw power. This guide compares dryers tested by Marie Claire UK's beauty team, covering different hair types, budgets and needs like travel and attachments.

products.name: Blow Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Most people who want strong all-round performance
products.summary: Marie Claire's overall winner and a Marie Claire UK Hair Awards winner. One of the lightest dryers tested at 360g, with a silent motor, self-cleaning function and both a diffuser and two nozzle options included.
cons: Not quite the fastest or most powerful tested

products.name: Italia Diffon Supreme
products.best_for: Curly hair that needs diffused, even heat
products.summary: A hairdryer and diffuser combined in one tool, easy to hold and shape curls with, and gentle enough to rest against the scalp without burning, though it's not useful for straightening and is fairly noisy.
pros: Wide nozzle covers more hair at once
Doesn't feel too hot on the scalp

products.name: Flight+ Travel Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Frequent travellers who don't want to compromise on power
products.summary: A compact travel dryer that folds down small without compromising on power, and switches between 120V and 240V, with a chic travel case included.

products.name: Helios Professional Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Fine hair that needs controlled, gentle drying
products.summary: A salon-grade dryer well suited to fine hair, with a long 3m cord for ease of use around a mirror.

products.name: Supersonic Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Thick hair that takes a long time to dry
products.summary: Marie Claire's pick for thick hair, built to dry faster without excessive heat damage, at a premium price point.

products.name: The Airshot Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Hair that needs gentler, less damaging heat styling
products.summary: Marie Claire's pick for damaged hair, designed to style with reduced heat damage compared with standard dryers.
products.search: Cloud Nine The Airshot Hair Dryer

products.name: SpeedStyle 5-in-1 Hair Dryer
products.best_for: Buyers who want drying and styling tools in one device
products.summary: Marie Claire's pick for a multi-purpose styler, combining a hair dryer with five styling attachments to replace several separate tools.
cons: Higher price for the added versatility

products.name: 2300 Hair Styler Dryer
products.best_for: Buyers who want solid performance on a budget
products.summary: Marie Claire's top pick for buyers wanting to stay under £100, offering decent power at an accessible price.

guide.q: How much power do I need?
guide.a: Marie Claire's experts recommend looking for at least a 1600W motor for faster drying with more control. Finer hair can get away with less power; thick or long hair benefits from higher wattage to reduce overall drying time.
Ionic dryers generate negative ions that counteract the positive charge of wet hair, which helps reduce frizz and smooth the hair cuticle as it dries.

guide.q: Why use the cool shot button?
guide.a: A blast of cool air after styling helps seal the hair cuticle and set your style faster, leaving hair looking shinier and helping it hold for longer. It's a commonly overlooked feature that stylists consistently recommend using.

A heavier dryer can cause arm fatigue during longer drying sessions, particularly with thick or long hair that takes longer to dry. If you have a lot of hair, a lighter dryer with strong power is generally more comfortable to use than a heavy, equally powerful one.
